title: a 10/10 double date night on Broadway @TheArtsInsider #sufjanstevens ...
transcript: What's better than one Cover Girl? Two cover girls! But what is the new Tony Award winning musical Illinois all about? Illinois is a dance musical that follows a group of campers who vulnerably share their deepest feels, bringing the iconic album by Sufjan Stevens to life on stage in an epic way. It's a 90 minute show with no intermission, which in my opinion, is the perfect show life. You feel your feels, get some merch, still plenty of time after the process said feels, hit the town and slide into bed by midnight. This is a limited run Broadway musical, so don't miss your chance to come feel the Illinois by August 10th.
